title: Lavaduct Lagoon
description: Calculate area of a polygon from dig instructions using Shoelace + Pick's theorem.
writeup:
## Approach

The dig instructions trace a closed polygon. Rather than filling in a grid, compute the area analytically.

## Part 1

Follow the direction and step count from each instruction to build polygon vertices. Use the Shoelace formula for the signed area, then Pick's theorem (`total = interior_area + perimeter/2 + 1`) to include the boundary cells.

## Part 2

The actual instructions are encoded in the hex color codes: the first 5 hex digits are the distance, the last digit encodes the direction (0=R, 1=D, 2=L, 3=U). The same Shoelace + Pick's formula works instantly even with millions-scale coordinates.
